implementation_gate.name: stage2_grpo_run_scoped_logging
implementation_gate.scope: Allocate each GRPO run directory atomically in the launcher, bind one non-shared training log to that exact run, hand the reserved directory to the online trainer, and refuse managed-artifact overwrite without changing training semantics.

run_allocation_and_logging.allocation_algorithm: scan the highest numeric run_N, then reserve max_plus_one with atomic mkdir and retry the next index when another launcher wins the same directory

failure_and_exit_contract.pre_allocation_launcher_failures: unexpected launcher arguments, forbidden environment variables, a missing CONFIG file, or inability to create the output root fail before consuming a run number and report on stderr
failure_and_exit_contract.post_allocation_failures: after a CONFIG file is accepted and run_N is reserved, YAML parsing, YAML field validation, Python startup, and Stage 1 source-checkpoint failures are captured in that run's training.log
failure_and_exit_contract.pipeline_status_capture: capture both entries from PIPESTATUS immediately after the Python-to-tee pipeline
failure_and_exit_contract.exit_status_record: append python_exit_status and tee_exit_status to training.log
